title: Open Task
description: Give Casey a task for your selected team.
team: Casey + your hires, with optional standby specialists

guide.intro: Give Casey a task for your selected team.
points: Hired only (default) uses your hires. Choose Hired + Standby to include backups.
Send /goal with the result you want. Name any agents to include and attach relevant files.
Track work in Mission Control, then open the answer and files in Results.
guide.note: Any hired role can participate. Remove /goal to chat directly with Casey.
